writeup.headline: Rockwell Automation rates Hold: strong margins and steady trend, but growth is slowing and the shares are priced above their usual range.
writeup.thesis: Rockwell scores 60, a Hold, five points short of the Buy band. Quality is the strongest factor at 77, backed by a 49.1% gross margin, a 22.7% operating margin, stock-based pay at 1.0% of revenue and a diluted share count down 1.2% year on year. Growth scores a middling 47: TTM revenue growth of 11.3% is solid, but latest-quarter revenue growth of 7.9% year on year means growth slowed by 4.0 pp from the previous quarter. The trend score of 64 reflects shares up 21.0% from 12 months ago to 1 month ago and the price 4.0% above its 200-day average, though it sits 10.4% below its 52-week high. News is roughly neutral at 51, with new product launches offset by broker price-target trims. Balance sheet and valuation had too little data to score, but on the inputs shown, absolute multiples of 5.5x sales and 25.6x EV/EBIT are high in absolute terms, and P/S is more expensive than at 53 of the last 61 month-ends.
key_risks: Revenue growth is decelerating, with growth slowed by 4.0 pp from the previous quarter.
Valuation is high in absolute terms (5.5x P/S, 25.6x EV/EBIT) and expensive against its own history, leaving little room for disappointment.
FY2026 results and FY2027 guidance on Nov. 5 could reset expectations for sales growth and EPS.
Cash covers only 0.15 times debt, so the balance sheet leans on debt.
Brokers trimmed price targets in October and consensus is Hold.
what_would_change: Up: a 5-point score gain would reach Buy, most likely from growth re-accelerating or upbeat FY2027 guidance lifting the growth and news factors.
Up: continued outperformance versus SPY and QQQ and a move back toward the 52-week high would strengthen the trend score.
Down: the score would need to fall 16 points to reach Sell, which would take a sharp growth slowdown, weak guidance or a breakdown in the share-price trend.
Down: margin erosion that pulled the quality score from 77 would remove the main support for the rating.
